📦 **SCP_Core `c221185`** — fix(library): resolve roots from host settings and validate persona

Library accepts operation data only. Host supplies one settings snapshot for the independent data and letters roots; comics uses the configured project snapshot. Validate existing absolute roots and known personas before writes. Document the current command contract.

Refs TASK-0379
